label: Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1, sense-fixed
paraphrase: Open sense bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: for every x, if x is CREATURE_2 (some other being causes x's being, IsCausedInBeingByAnother) then x is CREATURE_1 (some being that causes the being of every other being in act causes x's being, IsCreatureOfUniversalCause). Sense-fixed sibling of 'Whatever is CREATURE_2 (caused in being by another) is CREATURE_1' (b7d4eede-ab50-5522-8902-f33238fa234d): same content, but its Lean declaration names both sense constants instead of taking Creature as a parameter, so a statement bound to it cannot be instantiated at another sense. It gives b7d4eede by instantiation (causedInBeingByAnotherIsCreatureAtCreature1). SCOPE CONDITION (definition 80dea550): the divine processions are no instances of CausesIn c x esse with c distinct from x.
